notes.title: Afterdream is Available Now!
notes.content:
Today is THE Day!

After 2 years of development, Afterdream finally comes out.  Let's start this haunting journey with a magical camera.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1995880/_/

Price: $10.99 (10% off in the first week)
Tip: GG Fear bundle provide you with an extra 20% off discount for Afterdream
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35310/GG_Fear/

Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, Korean, and Japanese
Support Steamdeck : Yes!

In this mysterious world trapped between reality and dreams, you'll encounter diverse specters, gather intriguing items, solve enigmatic puzzles, and uncover the hidden reasons behind Jennifer's presence in this place.

We hope you will enjoy embarking on this journey with her.

Jesse Makkonen & Gamera Games

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!
notes.content:
Experience Dreams Like Never Before!

We're thrilled to show you the new RELEASE DATE TRAILER and announce that Afterdream is releasing on SEPTEMBER 28, 2023!

Watch the trailer and get ready to break through all barriers to reconnect with a lost loved one emerged!

[previewyoutube=MNQ5qBw_nEw;full][/previewyoutube]

Afterdream offers a singular 2D psychological horror experience with an arresting artistic style.You step into the shoes of Jennifer, exploring a mysterious world trapped between reality and dreams. 

Along this haunting journey, you'll encounter diverse specters, gather intriguing items, solve enigmatic puzzles, and uncover the hidden reasons behind Jennifer's presence in this place.

Play the Demo Now

Try Before You Buy.

We encourage all fans of the psychological horror genre and newcomers alike to download, play, and add this game to their wishlists. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42561538/91a8f0c9263c00874e1210879977e53af695904d.png

Be a part of Jennifer's thrilling journey through dreamscapes and reality by owning the game when it officially launches on September 28th.

Best
Jesse Makkonen
